title: Yabeenim fanah
intro: muuci diini aydaaduk yawqe, ginoh yaakumik ciggil sadah yan maxiqa quukah. Tama rooci inki yallih amriik ugutak gufeeh, xaleenak kaxxa malkit kalalak, ardi silsilatitte ken axawah gactaamak naharal ta baadal gexe. aydaadi fiddinowteh rammitle qarkaytok dagah qaran fan. Ah miyya takkem duuddaah?
clues: Anu Yallik astaa kee racmatta akkuk Is-raa-iil xayloh ruubeh suge.
Yi gufne dumah elle sugtennal masuginna — Anu 'Be!' ardi bagul yan abba sinnim.
Yi xaltani qangiinole xaafut garayte, takkay immay diini maybalaalaqa ken qellat sinna yaybeleeleqeenim kee ken guddaaqa fayya haanama.
qusba yooboke alqi kinnuk, anu inni xaqut yan mara cakkumsuteh yi xaltanih migaq qaddoosuh inni qarkaytok qaduk yaabak.
Yallih idinil, mano sinni kallayto weeloyseh, inti maleela mabul eceeh, barasa inni xagak dayliseh.
Anu biyak yoo xagaamak naharal qaran fanah ugteeh, ellecabo saaqat guftak naharal ta baad fanah aduureyyo.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Qaran fanah ugteeh, Qhiyaamah ayrok naharal aduurele
Jinniiy, seehadaa kee kimmir amoytah amoyta yekke.
outcome.answer: Jannati fanah ugteeh, Qhiyaamah ayrok naharal aduurele

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)
